a command's part, ask and put lines, in order

L0, L1: link cores, not ranks; each data-movement CPU holds a link

Ran: two P150A joined by four links, and one card split into two to four islands joined in each of the first five ways.
islands are a graph; a rank may be any number of links away

svg.text: On one island each of these is the group, its first rank and a local send: the same kernel runs on one card.
a kernel written by rank runs; one that knows its islands crosses less
Ranks are flat and contiguous by island. Between two cards a link runs through the router on an Ethernet tile of each card (row 1 of the
grid); on a split card it is a write over the card's own NoC. Every number is a run on two P150A joined by four links, or on a split card where said.
